key_insight: Normalizing flows can represent quantum gates as transformations between phase-space probability distributions, enabling a generative-model approach to classical quantum circuit simulation.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a potential route to more accurate neural simulation of large quantum circuits on classical hardware.
method: Represent N-qubit states as probability distributions on a smooth 2N-dimensional manifold.
Parameterize unitary gates as normalizing flows between these distributions.
Learn phase-space representations of quantum circuits using generative models.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on three common circuit families and higher accuracy than current state-of-the-art neural network methods at large system sizes.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify runtime, memory requirements, or training costs, so practical scalability remains unclear.
paper_title: Normalizing Flows for Classical Simulation of Quantum Circuits in Phase Space
